2026-11-c14.p: As shown in the figure, $\mathrm{ABC}$ is a right triangle with $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=3$, $\overline{\mathrm{BC}}=4$, and $\angle \mathrm{B}=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$. Let $\mathrm{D}$ be the point that internally divides segment $\mathrm{AB}$ in the ratio $2:1$.

Let $\mathrm{E}$ be the point where the circle centered at $\mathrm{A}$ with radius $\overline{\mathrm{AD}}$ meets segment $\mathrm{AC}$, and let $\mathrm{F}$ be the point, other than $\mathrm{D}$, where line $\mathrm{AB}$ meets this circle. Point $\mathrm{G}$ is chosen on arc $\mathrm{EF}$ so that $\overline{\mathrm{CG}}=2\sqrt{6}$.

Point $\mathrm{H}$ lies on the circle passing through the three points $\mathrm{C}$, $\mathrm{E}$, $\mathrm{G}$ and satisfies $\angle \mathrm{HCG}=\angle \mathrm{BAC}$. What is the length of segment $\mathrm{GH}$? [4 points]

2026-11-c21.p: For a cubic function $f(x)$ with positive leading coefficient and a real number $t$, the function
is continuous on the set of all real numbers and satisfies the following conditions.

box: (A) For every real number $a$, the value of $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to a+}\frac{g(x)}{x(x-2)}$ exists.
(B) The set of natural numbers $m$ for which the value of $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to m+}\frac{g(x)}{x(x-2)}$ is negative is $\left\{g(-1),\ -\dfrac{7}{2}g(1)\right\}$.

2026-11-c21.p: Find the value of $g(-5)$. (Given that $g(-1)\ne -\dfrac{7}{2}g(1)$.) [4 points]

2026-11-c22.p: Point $\mathrm{A}(a,\,b)$ on the curve $y=\log_{16}(8x+2)$ and point $\mathrm{B}$ on the curve $y=4^{x-1}-\dfrac{1}{2}$ both lie in the first quadrant.

The reflection of point $\mathrm{A}$ across the line $y=x$ lies on line $\mathrm{OB}$, and the midpoint of segment $\mathrm{AB}$ is $\left(\dfrac{77}{8},\ \dfrac{133}{8}\right)$. Then $a\times b=\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$.
(Here $\mathrm{O}$ is the origin, and $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]

2026-11-k30.p: Ten empty bags are placed in a row, and there are 8 balls. All the balls are distributed into the bags so that each bag contains at most 2 balls. Find the number of ways that satisfy the following conditions. (The balls are indistinguishable from one another.) [4 points]

box: (A) The number of bags containing exactly 1 ball is 4 or 6.
(B) Every bag adjacent to a bag containing 2 balls contains no balls.

2026-11-m28.p: and a positive number $t$, let $g(t)$ be the value of $s$ such that the distance between the foot of the perpendicular from the point $(s,\,f(s))\ (s>0)$ to the $y$-axis and the point where the tangent line to the curve $y=f(x)$ at $(s,\,f(s))$ meets the $y$-axis is $t$. What is the value of $\displaystyle\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{27}{4}}g(t)\,dt$? [4 points]
